task: R_multitick_window: multi-tick window snapshots (raw LOB at t={-5,-20,-50,-90}) added to T75 LGB L2 base. 4 lookbacks × 20 features = 80 new features (439 total vs 359 baseline). 3-seed (1/7/42) on V4 walk-forward split.
verdict: ABORT — multi-tick window snapshots NOT useful. Trick HURTS LOSO by 0.7~1.1 (DE 2D and 4D respectively). 3 of 5 syms regress; sym 4 (largest baseline contributor) loses -1.19.

diagnostic.feature_importance: Only 1 multi-tick feature appears in top-50 by gain (rank 46-49) per seed. The model essentially ignores them — schemeP's existing 359 features already capture intra-window dynamics adequately via rolling W20/W50/W100 stats, OFI, signed BV, EWMA, etc.
diagnostic.test_corr: trick test corr (0.1533) slightly LOWER than baseline (0.1567) — extra noise dimensions may be hurting generalization.
diagnostic.best_iter: trick best_iter slightly higher (90 vs 88) — model takes a few more rounds before early-stop, consistent with mild dilution.

notes: Multi-tick raw snapshots (t={-5,-20,-50,-90}) were hypothesized to add signal beyond schemeP's last-tick raw + window stats. Result is the opposite — the trick is redundant and slightly noisy. Conclusion: T100 W3 'cheap fix' hypothesis is REJECTED for LGB L2 on T75 base. NOT iter_018 candidate. iter_017 (T123) remains the leader.
